$Comment: Ice sword combo on the ground (2026-10-21, same as AT_Ice_King_Ice_Sword_Dive without flying): 0.6 s IceSwordSummon standing still, then IceSwordSwing1, IceSwordSwing2 (12 ice, 1 frost each, hit at 0.167 s) and the IceSwordSlash chop (28 ice, 2 frost), each started by a flat step at the player (ApplyForce 9 for the first, 5 for the others). Arcs in front of him only, no round explosion. CAE IceSwordSlash (phases 1 and 3), close range. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the sword in the hand opposite the nunchucks): only phase 3 uses it now, so every step plays the left-hand versions in set AT_Ice_King_Nunchucks (hidden Ice_Sword_Held_L on L-Hand, nunchucks stay in the right hand), same names and timing as the staff ones. 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): Sword_Summon as the sword appears, Sword_Swing on each of the three hit windows, Sword_Shatter when it bursts after the chop. 2026-10-22 (/hitdetection: the sword reached too wide and hit him standing on the other side): the two swings sweep 80 degrees (+-40 in front, were 120 = +-60) out to 4 blocks (were 5), the chop 50 degrees (+-25, were 90) out to 4.5 (5.5); ExtendBottom 1.5 (was 3, a leftover of the air dive). The arcs also turn with his head while they run, so a narrow sweep keeps the hit in front of him.

Interactions.$Comment: Rest of IceSwordSlash: the sword shatters at 0.37-0.4 s, the staff comes back at 0.6 s.
